edits.rationale: h1 unit 0 is dead on nominal; it reads friction_est with a negative weight so it fires only on wet surfaces
gate bias, set so the unit stays off on nominal friction
gate suppresses alpha_v-raising h2 unit 24 when wet
gate suppresses alpha_v-raising h2 unit 61 when wet
gate suppresses alpha_v-raising h2 unit 44 when wet
gate suppresses alpha_v-raising h2 unit 21 when wet
gate strongly drives h2 unit 0, which is dead on nominal, when wet
h2 unit 0 lowers alpha_v when wet
h2 unit 0 raises brake when wet

hypothesis: A wet-surface gate on h1 unit 0 (dead on nominal) reads friction_est. When wet, it suppresses the alpha_v-raising h2 units and drives dead h2 unit 0 to lower alpha_v and raise brake. The vehicle then slows enough to stay under the friction limit in wet curves, and nominal states are unchanged.
expected_effect: On wet states alpha_v drops and brake rises, so lat_accel_ratio falls well below 1.0 (rollouts on seeds 50000-50005 gave 0.18-0.33, all 6 passing). Nominal output shift is exactly 0. Wet episodes complete only about 56% of the route (driving score about 40), so they run slow.
